text:
eva: Heads-up — asia-east2 dedicated GPU pool just hit depletion, autoscaler failing to provision new nodes (quota errors). We should plan fallback to hosted in case this doesn't clear in 10m. :warning:

sam: I see it on the cluster dashboard. Node provisioning stuck with cloud API error: `quotaExceeded: requested 8 GPUs, available 0`. Queues growing on the dedicated side.

infra-bot: [ALERT] dedicated-pool asia-east2 capacity_low threshold breached (95%). Active requests queued. incident: https://pager/redwood/incident/9876 :rotating_light:

eva: Can we do a progressive reroute of traffic for model redwood-7b to hosted to avoid client 5xx? Prefer staged shift so we can watch latency.

kai: Agreed — recommend 30% -> 60% -> 100% increments. Keep the dedicated_weight tag so billing attribution stays clear. Also reduce max_concurrent_requests on hosted for the first stage to avoid a caching storm.

sam: Running the initial shift command now:
```
redwoodctl routes shift --from dedicated:asia-east2 --to hosted:asia-east2 --model redwood-7b --percent 30 --memo "apac depletion"
```

ashley: +1 from ops. I'll watch SLOs and prepare rollback criteria.

infra-bot: route update accepted. policy_id: rp-2026-33. Current shift: 30% hosted, 70% dedicated.

eva: Traffic at 30% hosted. Console shows latency +80ms for a subset of requests but no 5xx yet. Customers still within error budget.

sam: Autoscaler still failing — cloud responses show `quotaExceeded`. I've opened a priority case with cloud support (#CS-5521). ETA unknown. Posting brief error snippet:
```
autoscaler: failed to allocate instance: cloud.api.Error
code=QuotaExceeded region=asia-east2 requested_gpus=8 available_gpus=0
```

kai: Short-term tweak: enable warm-KV caching and increase local prefix cache on hosted nodes to cut backend calls. Rolling a small config patch now. That should reduce token-per-request cost spike and latency variance.

sam: Note for finance — hosted serving unit cost ~2.6x dedicated for redwood-7b. We'll record delta for the incident run and tag invoices.

eva: If cloud support doesn't clear quota in 15m, plan is to move to 60% then 100% by 30m. Ashley, can you publish rollback triggers?

ashley: On it. Rollback if error-rate > 1% or p99 latency > 500ms for more than 2m. I'll attach playbook to the incident.

sam: Update: cloud support acknowledged case, initial ETA 40m to increase quota. I'll keep polling. For now, moving to 60% in 10m unless we see severe degradation.

eva: OK. Keep this thread as the source of truth for handoff. Tag me when we're at 100% or when quota is resolved. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
